about: The game functions no matching target covers yet. tools/matching/remaining.py builds each from its whole source file with these flags and scores it against the retail exe. When one matches, move it into a real target in matching.json and take it out of here.

functions.name: CAM_ThTick
functions.note: Its C builds to the bytes Revenant's saved match makes (src/auto/8001b334.c). It joins cam-pose once CAM.c's .rodata has its retail address (CAM_SkyboxGlow's and CAM_ThTick's jump tables share it): read it from retail.objdump, then set function_rodata_addresses for both.
